profiles.title: Java profiles
profiles.emptyHint: A profile is a game version, a mod loader and its own folder for worlds and mods.
profiles.notInstalled: Not installed yet: the first launch downloads it.

hero.label: Launch Minecraft: Java Edition
hero.offline: No connection: the game starts offline with your last ownership check.

error.title: Couldn't start the game
error.noAccount: Sign in with a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition to play.
error.notOwned: This Microsoft account doesn't own Minecraft: Java Edition. Buy it on minecraft.net or switch to an account that owns it.
error.reauth: Your Microsoft account needs to sign in again.
error.noJava: No Java for this version on this system. Choose a Java in the profile's settings.
error.installer: The mod loader's installer failed. The log has its output.
error.noLoaderVersion: This mod loader has no build for this game version.
error.network: A download failed. Check your connection and try again: what is done is kept.

log.empty: The game's output shows here while it runs.

mods.vanilla: Pick Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge in the profile's settings to add mods.
mods.none: No mod in this profile yet.
mods.searchFailed: Modrinth can't be reached right now.
mods.source: Mods come from Modrinth, filtered for this game version and loader. Cheats are never offered.

form.description: Downloaded from the official servers of Mojang and of the mod loader at the first launch.
form.name: Name
form.memoryHint: How much RAM the game may use.
form.javaHint: Leave empty to use the Java Mojang provides for this version.
form.jvmArgsHint: Replace the version's suggested arguments. Memory is set above.
form.gameDirHint: Worlds, options and mods of this profile. Empty: the launcher's own folder.
form.deleteHint: The game files shared with other profiles stay.
form.deleteBody: The profile leaves the launcher. Worlds stay in its folder unless you delete the files too.
form.deleteFiles: Also delete its folder (worlds, mods, options)

bedrock.windowsOnlyHint: Bedrock Edition for computers is a Windows app from the Microsoft Store.
bedrock.missing: Bedrock Edition isn't installed on this PC.
